# Security Vulnerability Reporting

> **CRITICAL**: DO NOT report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues!

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Moonships, please follow our coordinated disclosure policy:

1. **GitHub Private Advisory**: Open a private advisory draft at [Security Advisories](https://github.com/bjo163/mwx-ships/security/advisories/new).
2. **Confidentiality**: Provide full reproduction steps, affected versions, and attack vectors privately.
3. **Response Time**: The maintainers will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and coordinate a patch and CVE disclosure timeline.

For full guidelines on supported versions and security practices, read our [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
